# NTT (News The Truth)

> Independent, State-of-the-Art Investigative Journalism Platform covering India, World, Politics, and breaking news.

## Core Sections

- [Latest News](https://newsthetruth.com/): Real-time breaking news and top stories
- [India News](https://newsthetruth.com/category/india): National news and policy analysis
- [World News](https://newsthetruth.com/category/world): Global affairs and international reporting
- [Politics](https://newsthetruth.com/category/politics): Political developments and governance
- [Archive](https://newsthetruth.com/archive): Historical article search and directory
- [Reporters & Editorial Desk](https://newsthetruth.com/reporter): Our verified newsroom journalists

## API & AI Feeds

- [News Sitemap](https://newsthetruth.com/sitemap-news.xml): XML sitemap for recent news articles
- [Main Sitemap](https://newsthetruth.com/sitemap.xml): Full site index
